context: Checkpoint 2026-08-02 (late). develop was pushed for the first time since 07-27 — 306 commits with no CI verdict on any of the interfaces/devices work. Judging them surfaced twelve defects in four classes, all fixed: three real product defects (spawn-env --local silently ignored via Commander ancestor filing — the 4th instance of the ancestor-option class, on the command this handoff tells operators to use; refarm hardening throwing instead of refusing; the hardening collector reporting a vendored capsule as phantom debt), two unfed CI registries (scaffold contract, TASK_SMOKE build order), two security highs (js-yaml pin, style-dictionary v5 — which also corrected double-quoted SCSS font tokens), and four stale or brittle assertions. Separately, the operator hit a real field bug on Termux: farm-start "<id>" only listed the catalog, because an absent --status/--cancel made indexOf return -1 and the filter dropped the first positional — the operation id. Parsing moved to remote-initiation.mjs as parseStartArgs (4 new tests, farm-client 200/200) and the kit was republished to ~/.refarm/dist/farm-client. The end-to-end proof had used POST /operations directly, so the kit's own path had never been exercised: proving a contract does not prove a surface. apps/refarm is 2715/2715 green in CI.
